About us

Acme Payments was founded in 2019 by two engineers who had spent years building payout systems inside larger marketplaces and were tired of rebuilding the same ledger every time. The company is forty people, of whom fourteen are engineers, and has been remote-first since the start.

The engineering team is organised around three services: the ledger, the payout scheduler, and the reconciliation pipeline. Every engineer is on call for the service they own, one week in six.

If you want to know what it is like to join, our people pages describe how we hire in detail.
